translation:
Koizumi is really great at apologizing, isn't
he? I admire how courteous he always is.

You're right. He has a way of avoiding the
consequences while properly apologizing.

I'm just impressed that he's so polite… What
do you mean, "consequences”?

Look, apologizing gives you a stronger
position, which allows you to intimidate others.

If you apologize in America, you lose. You
won't be able to win a single lawsuit.

Exactly—people here think that if you
apologize, you win.

Koizumi's skilled at apologizing so the other
party doesn't get the better of him.

Just as you'd expect from the person I named
as my deputy brigade chief.
It's all about inhibiting the other person.

So they can't force any annoying demands on
you.

Certainly, that's what it means to be good at
apologizing.
…B-but, I didn't mean it like that at aaall…
